records.percentage_basis: Share of 500 surveyed third-year literary students in six Ngaliema secondary schools who reported speaking the language
records.limitations: The sample covers students in six Ngaliema schools, not all residents of Ngaliema or Kinshasa. Multiple spoken languages could be reported, so percentages are not mutually exclusive.

records.evidence_locator: Table 1, pages 310-311: 165 of 500 surveyed students reported speaking Kikongo

records.limitations: The source uses the label Kikongo without identifying a variety. The sample covers students in six Ngaliema schools, not all residents of Ngaliema or Kinshasa, and allows multiple spoken-language responses.

records.evidence_locator: Table 1, pages 310-311: 120 of 500 surveyed students reported speaking Kiswahili

records.limitations: The source uses the broad label Kiswahili; the atlas links it to the Congo Swahili track as a review candidate. The school sample is not a citywide population estimate and allows multiple responses.

records.limitations: The school sample is not a citywide population estimate and allows multiple spoken-language responses. The source label Tshiluba is linked to the Ciluba ISO 639-3 track.
